$notes: P1 optimize: per-config RT path-solve + PHY LDPC QPSK 1/2 BLER -> throughput. Sweep_table has 15 rows (5 az x 3 dt). best.az_deg and best.dt_deg pick the config with highest throughput (ties broken arbitrarily — verifier matches any tied optimum). Output files: sweep_table.json (or .csv), optimization_result.json (this schema), simulation.py (the agent's code). MUST call sionna.rt.PathSolver and sionna.phy.* in the simulation script.
